notes.text:
Mendix OIDC Provider contains a token verification vulnerability that could allow an remote attack to hijack an Account.

Siemens has released new versions for the affected products and recommends to update to the latest versions.
notes.title: Summary

notes.text:
As a general security measure, Siemens strongly recommends to protect network access to devices with appropriate mechanisms. In order to operate the devices in a protected IT environment, Siemens recommends to configure the environment according to Siemens' operational guidelines for Industrial Security (Download: https://www.siemens.com/cert/operational-guidelines-industrial-security), and to follow the recommendations in the product manuals.

Additional information on Industrial Security by Siemens can be found at: https://www.siemens.com/industrialsecurity

notes.text: For further inquiries on security vulnerabilities in Siemens products and solutions, please contact the Siemens ProductCERT: https://www.siemens.com/cert/advisories

document.title: SSA-545865: Improper Token Verification Vulnerability in Mendix OIDC Provider Module

notes.text:
Affected versions of the module do not properly validate the integrity of JWTs submitted to the OIDC Provider Token Introspection endpoint, allowing tokens to be associated with legitimate token records based solely on their jti value.

This could allow unauthenticated remote attackers to hijack an account (session) when gaining access to an jti of an active token.
notes.title: CVE Description

remediations.details: Ensure that Resource Servers independently validate the cryptographic signature of incoming JWTs before accepting them, rather than relying solely on the OIDC Provider's Token Introspection endpoint to verify token validity.
